0022600161.text: The New York Knicks host the Brooklyn Nets in the Knicks' seventh game of the season. New York is 2-4 (1-2 at home), 11th in the East and fourth in the Atlantic, three games back, while Brooklyn is 0-5, 15th in the East and fifth in the Atlantic, 4.5 games back, having lost five straight. Jose Alvarado is out for the Knicks with an ankle sprain, and Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 93-92 win in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
